title: fix: tighten model monitor health thresholds
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Marks models degraded at 5% 5xx and off at 20% 5xx.
- Treats exactly 95% success as degraded and aligns success-rate colors with health status.
- Keeps 4xx client errors excluded from model health.

Test: `npm run build --prefix operations/model-monitor`

gist.headline: The hive checks its pulse
gist.blurb: The model monitor got a stricter little stethoscope. It now spots trouble sooner, while keeping client-side buzz out of the diagnosis.
gist.summary: Tightened model-monitor health thresholds so 5% 5xx errors marks a model degraded, 20% marks it off, exactly 95% success is degraded, and 4xx client errors remain excluded.
gist.impact: Users and operators get health colors that match model status more precisely, helping unreliable models be identified before they become fully unavailable.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a tiny garden caretaker using a stethoscope to inspect code-plants connected to a retro model-health monitor. The CRT robot displays a clear green healthy meter, a pastel amber degraded meter at 95%, and a calm off-status plant at 20% 5xx, while harmless 4xx leaves are sorted into a separate basket.
